caption: The drawing depicts a wooden door with three vertical panels, each showing natural wood grain in brown and tan tones. The door is set into a rectangular frame with a slightly arched top. Above the door, there is an ornate, symmetrical decorative element composed of a central red teardrop shape, flanked by curved lines and leaf-like pink extensions, with pointed red designs on each side. Red, blue, and pink are the primary colors in the decorative feature. The door rests on a surface made of reddish-brown square tiles, forming a small ledge. The background is light with faint, off-white shading to indicate the wall. The artist’s signature and the date "1926" are noted at the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Restoration Drawing
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
